reviews.comment:
No aceptaban VISA. Después que pagué las medialunas, me dieron unas todas quemadas (ver foto).  Cuando le pido para cambiarlas, estaban TODAS quemadas.  No sé como pueden poner a la venta algo así. No es un buen lugar para parar salvo que estés muy necesitado. Me pareció todo excesivamente caro.

(Translated by Google)
They didn't accept VISA. After I paid for the croissants, they gave me some that were completely burnt (see photo). When I asked to exchange them, they were ALL burnt. I don't know how they can sell something like that. It's not a good place to stop unless you're really desperate. I thought everything was excessively expensive.
